revisions.change_summary: Description of change: Added defined escalation criteria for when post-market trends must be escalated to CAPA; added Feedback Governance section defining the unified feedback loop (complaint data, CAPA trend data, management review outputs) with escalation triggers consistent with ISO 13485 clause 8.2.1. Reason for change: IA-2025 mNC 9; 2026 Quality Plan (Feedback Governance Procedure).
